content: Timefold 1.16.0 AbstractMove: createUndoMove is @Deprecated(forRemoval, since=1.16.0) — the solver now auto-generates undo moves internally via VariableChangeRecordingScoreDirector; custom moves only implement doMoveOnGenuineVariables(ScoreDirector) bracketed by beforeVariableChanged/afterVariableChanged, no manual undo move class needed.
